about: The Training pack's maps (J117.9-13): one per song, three per stage (Speed, Chords & jacks, Tech). tools/native/mania_pack.cpp builds each from its song's measured beats and the stage's rules.

maps.about: Half-beat runs and jumps on the beat: keep a steady pace with both hands.
Jumps on the kick and snare: two keys landing together, cleanly.
Your first holds: keep one finger down while the other hand taps.
Half-beat runs, jumps on the beat and short quarter-beat bursts, at 160.
Jumps on every hit: read which two keys come next.
Rolls and trills: fingers in order, evenly.
Quarter-beat streams with breathers: stamina starts here.
Light jumpstream and three-key hands on the big hits.
Trills, rolls and an anchored finger (runningman).
Jumpstream at 160: jumps inside a constant stream.
Chords that repeat a key (minijacks): hit the same key twice, fast.
Split trills: each hand trills its own keys, with holds under the stream.
Full jumpstream and the first handstream.
Chordjacks at half-beat: chords sharing keys, the heavy metal way.
Jumptrills, split trills and runningmen in a race.
Handstream at 160: three keys inside the stream.
Chordjacks with hands: keep the chords clean when keys repeat.
Inverse: every gap a hold. Read where to let go.
Dense jumpstream at 180 with 1/8 bursts.
Quarter-beat chordjack: jack speed under chords.
Split jumptrills and runningmen at 180.
Stamina: dense streams for nearly four minutes.
Gluts and jumpjacks at 188: chords that walk across the keys.
Holds and streams mixed: one hand holds, the other flies.
Fast handstream at 188.
Dense chordjack: hands and quads at 188.
Everything at 208: trills, anchors, inverse holds.
The final stream: dense handstream at 228.
The final chordjack: quads and hands at 208.
The final tech map: every skill at 208.
